Subject: Project Update: Revised Delivery Date of 14 April

Dear [Client Name],

I'm writing to update you on the timeline for your project. The third-party integration required for the platform has taken longer to certify than the vendor originally projected, and that certification is a prerequisite for the remaining build and testing work. As a result, the delivery date has moved by two weeks, with the new target completion now set for 14 April.

Our team is continuing development on all components that do not depend on the certification, so this delay will not affect the overall scope or quality of the final deliverable. We are in regular contact with the vendor to monitor progress and will let you know immediately if there is any further movement in either direction. Does the revised date of 14 April still work with your internal planning and any downstream commitments on your end?

In the meantime, please let us know if you would like a more detailed breakdown of the current project status or a short call to walk through the remaining milestones. We appreciate your continued partnership and will keep you closely informed as we move toward the new delivery date.

Best regards,
[Your Name]
